scripts.setup: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install && cd .. && node scripts/setup-env.js
scripts.dev: concurrently -n BE,FE -c yellow,cyan "cd backend && npm run wait-db && npm run dev" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.dev:embedded: node scripts/clear-marker.js && concurrently -n DB,BE,FE -c magenta,yellow,cyan "cd backend && npm run dev:db" "cd backend && npm run wait-db:embedded && npm run dev" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.start: concurrently -n BE,FE -c yellow,cyan "cd backend && npm start" "cd frontend && npm start"
